bio: Josué Mercereau 'de Moise en St. onge' married Marie Chadaine 'de Yers [Hiers] en St. onge' at the French Church of New York on 16 Jul 1693 (witnesses incl. Pierre Masse). Probably the Joshua (1658) ancestor of the Staten Island spy Joshua Mersereau.
sources: Registers of the French Church of New York, Collections of the Huguenot Society of America vol. 1 (1886): https://archive.org/details/collectionsofhug01hugu pp.29-31
